limits: This closes built-in disposable-file pattern cleanup only, not all of V1-05 or the whole V1 plan.
Standalone checkpoint GC, cold-storage movement, custom cleanup programs, Pro process control and natural-exit descendant closure are separate, still-open paths.
Success counts require unlink plus parent sync. A later I/O error may leave a file removed without a success count; no multi-file rollback or trash-recovery guarantee.
Fresh read-only authority and the shared task guard coordinate cooperative framework writers; they are not an OS sandbox, hostile same-UID defense or proof of all descendant closure.

Declaration-based retention does not assert scientific validity. Current B2 result artifacts inherit the confirmed training source's root; no distinct mutable evaluator-root protection claim is needed for that producer.
No real training, paid provider, production licensing change, GPU workload, holdout read, release, deployment, main merge, CPU autoresearch loop or general efficiency gain is claimed.
Source/test inventories and actual pytest completion footers are preserved; no claim that complete progress stdout was archived.
